claim_boundary: historical development evidence remains non-confirmatory; the serving-contract amendment is landed and frozen, but no prospective observation may count until the pinned specialist runtime proof is verified, fresh exact-source coverage is available and Phase 7 is explicitly activated for prospective evidence

prospective_serving_contract.reason: Phase 5 applied the Kronos five-step half-size modifier only on the frozen 96-of-1308 development diagnostic sample and treated absent path rows as neutral. The prospective rule below preserves that exact 8/109 activation density with future-only deterministic spacing instead of broadening Kronos to every origin.
prospective_serving_contract.market_model_training: fit the frozen histgb-core-v1 once from verified target-complete origins ending no later than 2022-12-31; never add 2023+ or prospective outcomes to this fit during this freeze
prospective_serving_contract.market_source_binding: the operational decision path must derive source identity from exact on-disk Databento definition/statistics/OHLCV partition triples covering the origin trade date, persist per-file SHA-256 plus a canonical manifest hash, and reject caller-supplied source-snapshot identity
prospective_serving_contract.decision_frequency: derive and log every otherwise eligible fresh decision-time origin; evidence independence is enforced only when counting non-overlapping five-session episodes
prospective_serving_contract.timesfm_short_veto: require the pinned TimesFM 2.5 point-return feature at every otherwise eligible prospective origin using PIT-known same-contract history and the frozen model identity
prospective_serving_contract.specialist_generation: operational prospective decisions generate TimesFM/Kronos outputs inside the pinned serving path from internally decoded exact-source Databento histories; caller-supplied specialist numeric outputs or provenance are forbidden, and activation remains fail-closed until the exact runtime proof and fresh-source gates pass
prospective_serving_contract.session_generation: operational daily session accounting derives held-contract identity, execution prices and source identity inside the verified Databento serving path; caller-supplied execution prices or source identity are forbidden, and activation remains fail-closed until the exact runtime proof and fresh-source gates pass
prospective_serving_contract.operator_timestamping: supported prospective CLI writes use actual process time; caller-provided recorded_at/backdating overrides are not exposed

specialist_runtime_proof.reason: The exact retained TimesFM/Kronos inference runtime is not currently executable in this worktree and the frozen 23:59-input to next-00:00-fill timing budget has not been proven. Prospective activation must not assume specialist inference can finish and be durably recorded before the planned fill.
required_evidence: exact pinned TimesFM and Kronos checkpoint/source identities verified in the serving runtime
decision-time specialist outputs generated by the serving path rather than supplied as final forecast/action outputs
measured prewarmed decision latency demonstrates durable decision recording before the frozen planned fill or the origin is skipped without backfill

kronos_path_availability.eligible_origin_counter_start: zero at the first otherwise eligible prospective origin strictly after this serving-contract amendment is landed and activated
kronos_path_availability.counter_advances_on: every otherwise eligible fresh decision-time origin, regardless of signal sign, risk state or later outcome
kronos_path_availability.spacing_intent: preserve the development diagnostic's outcome-blind approximately even spacing without requiring future block totals
kronos_path_availability.inactive_origin_semantics: kronos_terminal_return is unavailable/neutral; no path half-size modifier may fire
kronos_path_availability.active_origin_semantics: generate the pinned Kronos-base native five-step path with upstream_usage_defaults and permit only the frozen disagreement-based half-size modifier

prospective_serving_contract.daily_economic_accounting: record held-contract session PnL, execution sides, frozen costs, equity, daily loss, peak drawdown and persistent kill state independently of overlapping five-session evidence episodes
prospective_serving_contract.start_boundary: no prospective observation counts until this amendment is landed and its exact landing identity is recorded as active

adaptive_development.reason: These outcomes were used for candidate selection, diagnostics and Phase-6 robustness work; repeated reuse cannot create fresh confirmation evidence.

pre_freeze_reserved_history.reason: The frozen candidate depends on TimesFM/Kronos-derived roles. Foundation-model checkpoint pretraining exposure and historical checkpoint availability prevent a defensible pristine historical-confirmation claim for this candidate.

prospective_evidence_contract.start_boundary: first decision timestamp strictly after the prospective serving-contract refreeze is landed and activated on the registered default branch
prospective_evidence_contract.independence_rule: Count at most one decision episode per non-overlapping five-session target window.

prospective_interpretation.success: All minimum coverage/logging requirements pass and the frozen economic gate passes without post-freeze tuning.
prospective_interpretation.failure: The frozen candidate breaches a hard economic/risk gate after minimum evidence is reached, or prospective logging proves the candidate cannot be reproduced under its frozen execution contract.
prospective_interpretation.inconclusive: Minimum elapsed, episode, directional-exposure or logging-fidelity requirements are not yet satisfied.
prospective_interpretation.phase8_entry: Allowed only after prospective success; Phase 8 hardening cannot rescue an inconclusive or failed edge.

decisions_and_assumptions.decision: Retain the Phase-5 candidate unchanged after Phase 6 rejected annual policy refitting.
decisions_and_assumptions.risk: The selected candidate remains weak adaptive-development evidence and may fail prospectively.
decisions_and_assumptions.revisit_trigger: A new independently justified research identity or qualifying prospective evidence; never post-result tuning within this freeze.

decisions_and_assumptions.decision: Do not consume pre-freeze 2023+ history as pristine confirmation for this foundation-model-dependent candidate.
decisions_and_assumptions.risk: This preserves independence at the cost of foregoing a potentially useful historical score.
decisions_and_assumptions.revisit_trigger: A defensible checkpoint-pretraining and historical-availability audit may permit a narrower qualified claim, but cannot retroactively create pristine independence.

decisions_and_assumptions.decision: Require one full year and at least 40 non-overlapping five-session episodes before a Phase-8 edge claim.
decisions_and_assumptions.risk: Evidence accumulation is slower but reduces seasonal and overlapping-window overinterpretation.
decisions_and_assumptions.revisit_trigger: Only an outcome-independent feasibility defect may justify a new preregistered contract; observed P&L cannot relax this threshold.
